biotools.summary: TRACE-DT audits necessary and possible membership and exact pairwise substitution bounds in fixed-capacity ranked score tables. It provides a Python command-line tool, candidate-level reports, tests and reproducible examples. Applications use frozen Open Targets cancer target scores and DISEASES resource views. Necessary membership is a computational guarantee conditional on the declared scores and does not establish biological or therapeutic validity. Author-owned software is MIT; data and third-party components retain their source-specific rights.
